for_the_owner: Judgment call: TAVI's README says six demonstrations for each of six Allegro + XELA tasks are public on Google Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IpU97D4nSosdyyWmvuLO-E3phRA-nf8c). They were not opened or catalogued as a dataset; add a survey if a small T-Dex-style demo set should be listed.

Judgment call: OmniVTLA's ObjTac (56 objects, 135K Paxini Gen2 tactile-video-text samples, Google Drive and omnisharingdb.paxini.com) was not catalogued because neither the paper nor the project page says whether the touches were made by a hand, a gripper or a handheld sensor.
notes: 60 queue candidates (positions 0-59) decided, plus 1 search-sweep record (UniTacHand, arXiv 2512.21233): 61 in total. 3 models added, no datasets.

Positions 0-59 were mostly LeRobot checkpoints from eunjuri and Tna001 with no paper (rejected as last night) and openalex citation hits; the queue's next slots include in-scope-looking items: TacClaw-Infinity project page (gh:tacclaw-infinity/tacclaw-infinity.github.io, 'Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation'), Touch-JEPA arXiv 2610.28519, ReDex arXiv 2610.07525 and the armteam HapticWAM sets (arXiv 2609.23888).
Lead doi:10.1007/s41315-026-00521-2 (Springer review of tactile dexterous hands): the article page redirects to a Springer login, so the datasets and models it names were not checked.
ASCL (doi:10.1109/tase.2025.3585040) set to 'later': named grasp-stability model for multi-fingered hands, closed access, hand and data not named in the sources found.

Search hits already in the catalog or reviewed: TachinGlove, OpenTouch, TactiDex, VTouch++, SmartHand, ADL-21, UVTA, DexViTac, HORA, RoboTacDex, HapTile, PalmDex, TactAlign, OSMO, Spark-0/HumanTouch, TTP, DexTouch-WM. Baihu-VTouch (60,000 min cross-embodiment vision-touch set, OpenLoong) appeared only in a CGTN news article; its 380+ tasks and 100+ skills match VTouch++ (rejected 2026-10-29, gripper only); not recorded without a primary source.
Still pending from earlier notes: DexMani arXiv 2608.00554, the chang-xinhai and cyanhaze awesome-list items, and N0-Foundation / OpenNeoData 2608.29601.
